# The standard pictures of the screenshots workflow: the demo song by night and day, the boss bar, the settings at
# every GUI scale and in Hebrew, the layouts, the top bar, the night skies. Format: .github/scripts/game-check.sh.
# Leave the game the way you found it at the end of each part (placement, layout, sky, time, GUI).

set growWord true
set barClock true
cmd weather clear
cmd time set midnight
cmd gamerule doDaylightCycle false
cmd gamerule advance_time false
look 0 -28
sleep 12
shot night-sky
sleep 3
shot night-sky-2
cmd time set noon
sleep 8
shot daytime
cmd bossbar add skylyrics:test "Made Up Boss"
cmd bossbar set skylyrics:test players @a
sleep 4
shot boss-bar
cmd bossbar remove skylyrics:test
set placement FLOATING
look 0 0
sleep 6
shot floating
set placement SKY
cmd time set midnight
guiscale 1
gui 0
sleep 4
shot settings-scale-1
guiscale 2
gui 0
sleep 4
shot settings-scale-2
guiscale 3
gui 0
sleep 4
shot settings-scale-3
guiscale 4
gui 0
sleep 4
shot settings-scale-4
guiscale 2
gui 3
sleep 3
shot settings-display
close

# The settings and the top bar in Hebrew, which reads right to left
lang he_il
# reloading the game's resources takes a while on a software screen
sleep 15
gui 0
sleep 4
shot hebrew-settings-lyrics
gui 2
sleep 3
shot hebrew-settings-music
close
lang en_us
sleep 10

# The sky lyrics layouts: the arc by night and by day, words standing in the world, and the stacked lines.
# Arc lines appear where you look when they start, so each look is followed by a wait for the next line.
set layout ARC
cmd time set midnight
look 0 -12
sleep 10
shot lyrics-arc-night
sleep 4
shot lyrics-arc-night-2
# The same drawn in the world pass instead of over the finished picture
set layer WORLD
sleep 6
shot lyrics-arc-night-world
set layer AUTO
cmd time set noon
look 0 -12
sleep 8
shot lyrics-arc-day
# Words in the world: look a little down so they stand around the crosshair, then step aside and turn
set layout WORLD
look 0 8
sleep 8
shot lyrics-world-day
cmd execute as @p at @p run tp @s ~1.5 ~ ~1
look 20 8
sleep 1
shot lyrics-world-day-moved
sleep 5
shot lyrics-world-day-2
cmd execute as @p at @p run tp @s ~-1.5 ~ ~-1
set layout LINES
cmd time set midnight
look 0 -28
sleep 6
shot lyrics-lines
set layout ARC
look 0 -28
sleep 2

# The top bar: a sung line, the widest line, the song's name between lines, and GUI scales 1 to 3. Each `seek`
# puts the demo song 2.5 s before the moment wanted, so the picture after the sleep lands on it.
cmd time set midnight
look 0 -28
set barClock true
set barStats true
guiscale 3
sleep 3
# "Build it up and let it go", halfway
seek 46.8
sleep 2.5
shot hud-scale-3
# the longest line, near its end
seek 32.3
sleep 2.5
shot hud-scale-3-long
# between lines: title and artist
seek 35
sleep 2.5
shot hud-scale-3-between
guiscale 1
sleep 3
seek 23
sleep 2.5
shot hud-scale-1
guiscale 2
sleep 3
seek 23
sleep 2.5
shot hud-scale-2

# Night sky effects: the synthwave sky, the eclipse and the constellations. The lyrics are pinned to the north, so
# the suns sit just right of and below them. Seen from a glass block 40 blocks up so hills don't hide the suns.
cmd weather clear
cmd time set midnight
close
set direction NORTH
cmd execute as @a at @s run fill ~-1 ~39 ~-1 ~1 ~39 ~1 minecraft:glass
cmd execute as @a at @s run tp @s ~ ~40 ~
sleep 3
set sky SYNTHWAVE
look 192 -16
sleep 8
shot sky-synthwave
look 206 -5
sleep 6
shot sky-synthwave-sun
set sky ECLIPSE
look 184 -20
sleep 8
shot sky-eclipse
look 150 -32
sleep 6
shot sky-eclipse-milky-way
set sky OFF
look 196 -26
sleep 8
shot sky-constellations
set sky AURORA
look 258 -34
sleep 6
shot sky-aurora-constellations
# Back down, glass gone; the synthwave sky once more from the ground
cmd execute as @a at @s run tp @s ~ ~-40 ~
cmd execute as @a at @s run fill ~-1 ~39 ~-1 ~1 ~39 ~1 minecraft:air
set sky SYNTHWAVE
look 196 -14
sleep 6
shot sky-synthwave-ground
set sky AURORA
set direction FOLLOW
look 0 -28
sleep 3

# The settings rows: the Lyrics and Look tabs at GUI scale 2 and 3, scrolled to the middle and the end (a scroll
# step is 24 GUI px; big steps stop at the bottom of the tab)
guiscale 2
gui 0
sleep 4
shot settings-2-lyrics
scroll -20
sleep 2
shot settings-2-lyrics-end
gui 1
sleep 3
shot settings-2-look
scroll -5
sleep 2
shot settings-2-look-mid
scroll -20
sleep 2
shot settings-2-look-end
guiscale 3
gui 0
sleep 4
shot settings-3-lyrics
scroll -20
sleep 2
shot settings-3-lyrics-end
gui 1
sleep 3
shot settings-3-look
scroll -5
sleep 2
shot settings-3-look-mid
scroll -20
sleep 2
shot settings-3-look-end
# The Lines layout brings back the previous and next line rows; World hides placement and direction
guiscale 2
set layout LINES
gui 0
sleep 3
# the screen places itself on its first frame, so scroll after it shows
scroll -4
sleep 2
shot settings-lines-layout
set layout WORLD
gui 0
sleep 3
shot settings-world-layout
set layout ARC
gui 3
sleep 3
scroll -4
sleep 2
shot settings-display-bar
close
# Hebrew reads right to left: the new rows have to fit there too
lang he_il
sleep 15
gui 1
sleep 4
shot hebrew-settings-look
# the longest sky name, and the arrows around it
set sky SYNTHWAVE
scroll -20
sleep 2
shot hebrew-settings-look-end
close
lang en_us
set sky AURORA
sleep 10
